GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 423 (22 Nov 45) ESS-IE
(SCAPIN-346)
26 November 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : THE IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Release of Raw Silk, Semi and Finished Goods.
1. Reference is made to CLO No. 519 (2), dated 8 November 1945, requesting the release of raw silk, semi and finished goods for home consumption.
2. It is directed that all raw silk bales be immediately graded and this headquarters be furnished with a list of all lots by bale number, lot number, grade, colour, and denier.
3. It is further directed that:
a. All short cut fibres in Table II (1) be released to domestic manufacturers for home consumption.
b. All mills having semi-finished greige goods in the looms as indicated in Table II (2) be instructed to complete the warps. Upon completion of warps, this headquarters is to be furnished a complete list describing the fabric with swatches, construction, use, lot number, piece numbers, colour, and yardage.
c. The controlling guilds holding all finished goods immediately furnish this headquarters a complete list according to guilds, describing the fabric with swatches, construction, use, lot number, piece numbers, colour, and yardage.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H.W.ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
